leverage.exposure: A leveraged position is open and has been for days. It costs nothing until the instant the matchday locks, and the lock is still well over five days out, so this is a scheduled unwind rather than an emergency — and it is NOT a reason to kill a buy on its own. What constrains a purchase is whether it can be unwound by the lock, never the mere existence of a deficit. The scheduled two-leg sale clears the deficit to positive with the squad landing exactly on the floor of eleven, which is why no third sale is available and why no purchase of any size fits. Flips sit outside this entirely: each is its own unwind leg and is closed out the same night, so they neither deepen nor relieve the standing position. The one thing that would turn this into an alarm is the unwind not being executed; the trigger date for leg one is open now and leg two is set for the fifth.

binding_gap: The binding gap is the defensive slot that opens the moment Treu is sold, which Nakuzola then fills on a fraction of Treu's average. It has no remedy on this board and that has now been confirmed twice: the candidates checked previously were both out of their clubs' probable elevens, and the only defender on the board who would genuinely improve the slot cannot be funded inside the unwind. The gap is therefore accepted, not solved — it is the price of clearing the deficit, and the pairing that incurs it was chosen precisely because it costs fewer fielded points than any alternative. The cheap floor-priced remedy that an earlier watch invited has been hardened into an avoid and is in any case no longer on the market; that call is now closed as factually dead.

verdict.headline: A quiet run on points and a live one on value.
verdict.headline_short: A quiet run on points and a live one on value.
verdict.detail: A quiet run on points and a live one on value. Nothing on this board can be bought: every defender worth owning sits far above what the unwind ceiling permits, so the squad Georg fields on matchday five is the squad he already owns. The scheduled unwind — Treu first, Ruoppi after — stands exactly as written and is deliberately NOT to be executed today; the lock is still days away and both legs are rising, so every day held pays. What is live is the value trade: two Kickbase board listings qualify under the measured tick doctrine, and the larger of the two expires late this morning. Nothing was reversed this run, and no squad player is newly unavailable.

sell.reason: Both standing sales are open, valid and untouched. Treu is listed by Georg at his standing ask and remains unsold; he is the first and larger unwind leg and the only thing that clears the deficit. Ruoppi is leg two and the timing is the whole call — he carries a rising flag, he is not in the placed eleven, and the deadline is the lock, not today. No run between now and the fifth should sell him early or re-derive the pairing; that derivation was done independently and the Treu-plus-Ruoppi pair beat every alternative by a wide margin on fielded points. The one caution on Ruoppi is already logged: he fell at the last tick while still carrying a rising flag, so the hold-for-appreciation premise is damaged rather than dead, and his last-day movement is negative even as his longer trend is positive.

WHY HE IS THE RIGHT LEG 2 AND NOT A KEEPER: ap 28 over 4 matchdays, the second-weakest body in the squad after Nakuzola (ap 27), and he is NOT in the placed XI, so selling him cannot reduce the fielded eleven. No current dated info found on his starter status this run (searched 02.10; only undated profile pages returned) — recorded as "no current info found", not as a clean bill. WHY NOT NOW: selling back to Kickbase pays EXACTLY mv, so an immediate sale crystallises a 420.194 loss. He is mvt 1, and the measured next-tick drift for mvt 1 this run is +2,49% (n=661, 87,7% rose). There are SEVEN 20:00Z ticks between now and the MD5 lock. Recovering the +6,91% premium needs roughly three of them, so he should be back above the 6.500.000 paid from about 05.10. SELL HIM ONCE mv >= 6.500.000, and in any case BEFORE 2026-10-09T18:30:00Z — a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole matchday, and that risk outranks recovering the premium. If mv has still not reached 6.500.000 by the 08.10 run, sell anyway and take the loss: the deadline binds, the premium does not.

buy.reason: No buy this run, and the reason is arithmetic rather than taste. The squad sits at thirteen with eleven placed, so without a purchase only two players can leave before the floor bites, and those two are Treu and Ruoppi. A purchase buys exactly one extra sale — Nakuzola, who is floor-priced — so the most a new signing may cost is whatever that third leg adds on top of the two already committed, and that is a trivial sum. Nothing on the board that would improve the post-unwind eleven comes close to fitting inside it. Querfeld is the one genuine defensive upgrade available and his seller has already cut the ask into the manager-ask low cluster, which makes the price fair and still makes him unaffordable; he stays avoided on the unwind ceiling and emphatically not on merit, and no later run may re-open him by citing that merit. The remaining asks on the board are manager listings at markups far outside anything that has ever cleared in this league.

movers.reason: The flip window is wide open and two Kickbase board listings qualify. Both are board listings with no manager attached, both are priced at exactly market value, both carry the rising flag, and — the test that disqualifies most candidates — both expire BEFORE tonight's valuation update, so a win still captures the tick. Ebnoutalib is the larger and expires late this morning; Tella is the smaller version of the identical trade at roughly a quarter of the exposure, expiring this evening, and is the one to take if the concentration on a single striker is unwanted. Bid EXACTLY market value on either and NEVER raise: winning captures the tick, losing costs nothing, and chasing a contested listing into the high cluster destroys the edge outright — one bad clear wipes out ten good flips. Both together fit comfortably inside spending power, neither reduces the fielded eleven, and each is its own unwind leg, so neither consumes any of the capacity the Treu-and-Ruoppi unwind needs. Selling back to Kickbase pays market value exactly, with no spread. Neither man can leave the league before the tick — the summer window is shut and the only exit story in circulation, a Turkish loan interest in Tella, is explicitly a January matter. The Ebnoutalib flip is NOT a reversal of the points avoid on him: that call killed him on the unwind ceiling and still stands. Re-measured this run, the edge is intact and the sample has grown by half again since it was first measured, with the mean drift and the hit rate both essentially unchanged — no decay to report. Two questions remain open and neither has been resolved: whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap how many flips can run at once, and the fact that this edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if rivals crowd in. Rivals here already flip the daily tick constantly, injured players included, and for a pure value trade that is correct — fitness does not enter the tick.

fitness.sweep: The sweep is clean: no squad player is newly injured, suspended, benched, or carrying dated news that he may leave the league. Two squad members carry a non-zero status flag and both are explained on dated sources. Gruber is tagged knocked-about rather than out, and his club's probable eleven for the coming matchday — on a source dated the third — still names him; Mainz's genuine absentees are two other men entirely. Worth recording because the two instruments disagree: his own profile page reads like a man who is out, because its absence counter tallies games already missed, while the probable eleven is the forward-looking instrument and is the one that governs. Ruoppi's flag has a dated cause from the second — a knee irritation described as precautionary, with availability to be decided after the international break — and he is a backup who does not appear in that probable eleven, which is precisely the premise his sale rests on. Zentner is on the board carrying an injury flag and a multi-week hand injury; he is not a candidate for anything.
